title: A footloose entrepreneur model in a continuous space
abstract: arXiv:2505.11241v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper studies a footloose entrepreneur model in a continuous space. In an appropriate function space, the model is formulated as an initial value problem for an infinite-dimensional ordinary differential equation. A unique global solution is constructed based on the Banach fixed point theorem. The stability of a homogeneous stationary solution is then investigated, and numerical simulations of the asymptotic behavior of global solutions under different parameter values are performed. Numerical solutions starting near the unstable homogeneous stationary solution converge to spike-shaped non-homogeneous stationary solutions, and the number of spikes decreases with declining transport costs. An analysis of the stability of non-homogeneous stationary solutions supports this observation.

translated_title: 连续空间中的自由企业家模型
translated_abstract: 本文研究了连续空间中的自由企业家模型。在适当的函数空间中，该模型被表述为一个无穷维常微分方程的初值问题。基于Banach不动点定理，构造了唯一的全局解。随后研究了同质稳态解的稳定性，并对不同参数取值下全局解的渐近行为进行了数值模拟。从不稳定同质稳态解附近出发的数值解收敛于尖峰状的非同质稳态解，且尖峰数量随运输成本的降低而减少。对非同质稳态解稳定性的分析支持了这一观察结果。
tldr: 该论文将连续空间中的自由企业家模型表述为无穷维常微分方程初值问题，利用Banach不动点定理证明全局解的唯一存在性，并通过稳定性分析与数值模拟揭示经济活动会自发集聚形成尖峰状非同质稳态，且集聚区数量随运输成本下降而减少。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates a footloose entrepreneur model in continuous space as an infinite-dimensional ODE initial value problem, proves existence and uniqueness of global solutions via the Banach fixed point theorem, and shows that economic activity spontaneously agglomerates into spike-shaped non-homogeneous steady states whose number decreases as transport costs decline.
